name: Outlook Calendar
summary: Microsoft's calendar in Outlook on the web.

flows.title: Create an event or meeting
steps: At the bottom of the page, select Calendar.
Click the calendar at the day and time of the event, or select New event at the top of the page.
Add a title. For an all-day event, select the All day toggle.
To invite people, type their names or email addresses in the Invite required attendees box.
Type a location in the Search for a room or location box.
Select Save for an appointment for yourself, or Send for a meeting with attendees.

flows.title: Share a calendar
steps: In Calendar, on the toolbar at the top of the page, select Share, and choose the calendar to share.
Enter the name or email address of the person to share it with.
Choose how they can use it: Can view when I'm busy, Can view titles and locations, Can view all details, Can edit, or Delegate.

flows.title: Create or add a calendar
steps: Select Calendar, then Add calendar, then Create new calendar.
Give the calendar a name, and customize it with a color, a charm, or both. Optionally add it to an existing calendar group.
To add a person's calendar instead, select Calendar, then Add calendar, then Add a person's calendar. Type the name of the person, group or resource, and select Save.
